Aisha Nguyen: Morning everyone — kickoff for Scout Health onboarding. Hi @Priya, looping in Jordan and Mateo. Goals: 1) production host by 2026-05-05; 2) <5% error rate on inference; 3) team enablement + runbook. Can Priya confirm internal stakeholders, and any compliance constraints (SAML, data residency)?
Priya Kumar: Thanks Aisha — 👋 stakeholders: me (project lead), Ravi Patel (infra), Lina Gómez (security). We need EU data residency and SAML SSO. Timeline ok but can we push production to 2026-05-12 depending on SSO slot?
Jordan Lee: Noted SAML/EU. Tech checklist: service account for sandbox, IP allowlist, sample prompt/traffic for perf baseline. If you can share a subset of typical prompts (+100 requests) that helps tuning.
Mateo Rios: I'll set up a weekly 30m sync (Tues 9am PT) starting 2026-04-08. Action items for week 1: 1) creds & sandbox 2) SSO discovery 3) perf dataset from Priya. I'll drop a calendar invite.
Priya Kumar: I can provide perf data — sending an export link to S3 later today. Also need a playbook for rollback if latency spikes during ramp.
Aisha Nguyen: Good call on rollback. Jordan — can you draft an incident runbook snippet we can include in the playbook? Short checklist ok. @OnboardBot can you add "runbook draft" to the onboarding checklist?
OnboardBot: ✅ Added "runbook draft" to Scout Health onboarding checklist. Current checklist: sandbox creds, SSO config, perf baseline, runbook draft, UAT signoff.
Jordan Lee: Drafted minimal runbook snippet:
```
- If 95th percentile latency > 1.2s for >10m -> scale pool + alert on-call
- If error rate > 3% -> rollback to previous model version and open incident
- Contact: Mateo Rios (eng), Aisha Nguyen (CS)
```
Mateo Rios: I'll handle autoscale policy and talk to infra (Ravi) about reserved capacity for peaks. Priya — please confirm preferred maintenance windows.
Priya Kumar: Maintenance window: Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC preferred. Also flagging a renewal concern: procurement wants cost predictability. Can Redwood provide a cost-estimate for 6 months of expected usage? Need that by next Friday.
Aisha Nguyen: We'll run an initial cost forecast from your perf baseline; I'll own the deliverable and send by 2026-04-12. Also, can someone from security (Lina) join the SSO discovery session? Jordan — suggest a 30m pre-SSO with Lina and Ravi.
Jordan Lee: Agree. I'll invite Lina and Ravi to the SSO call. Anything else? :thumbsup:
Priya Kumar: All good for now. Thanks team — excited to get started :rocket:
Aisha Nguyen: Thanks all. Calendar invite + onboarding doc links incoming. We'll use this thread for quick syncs; prefer short updates here.
